verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents a broad first-party REST API covering record CRUD, metadata reads for modules, fields, layouts and custom views, bulk read/write up to 25,000 records, COQL queries, composite calls and change notifications, so much of the UI's data work is reachable programmatically. Nothing claims full UI parity, though, and the metadata API is documented only for fetching, not for creating or changing configuration. Zia's ability to create modules and workflows is an AI assistant feature, not API parity. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API endpoints for configuration such as creating modules, layouts, workflows and reports, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
Fetch the metadata of modules, fields, layouts, custom views, and related lists.
This API allows you to insert, update, or upsert a maximum of 25000 records in a single API call.
CRM Object Query Language(COQL) uses the SELECT query to fetch records from Zoho CRM.
Combine up to five API calls in a single request through this API.
